description: Apply official Unicode combining marks (long stroke U+0336, short stroke U+0335, slash U+0338, or underline U+0332) to text, strip those marks, or wrap the plain text as Markdown/Discord, Slack/WhatsApp or HTML strikethrough. Each visible character, including an emoji, gets one mark. Line breaks are left alone. Input is not stored.

markup.description: For markup: markdown (default; also discord), slack, or html

strike_spaces.description: For apply, mark spaces as well as letters, default true

style.description: For apply: long (default), short, slash, or underline

text.description: Text to mark, strip, or wrap

name: strikethrough_text
title: Add or strip official Unicode strikethrough marks, or return native markup
